Name: Enemy Health Bars (SMAPI)
Author: OrSpeeder
Description:
[size=3]Current version is 1.7 for SMAPI 0.39.2
<br />
<br />Features:
<br />
<br />[list]
<br />[*]Non-cheaty, to see more precise information you need more combat skill, or kill more of the enemy type.
<br />[*]Hand-crafted position for the bars, they should be in the right place for most enemies.
<br />[*]Can handle 1.05 zoom properly.
<br />[*]Bar can get bigger or smaller to reflect enemy size or power.
<br />[*](1.5) Show numeric value of enemy health.
<br />[*](1.5) Configurable colour scheme.
<br />[*](1.6) Enemies that rely on you not noticing them on the screen need to be hit once to show the health bar (example: shadow enemies, that rely on shadows...)
<br />[/list]
<br />Other suggestions of Combat UI is welcome.
<br />
<br />Using: just unpack the .zip on StardewValley "mods" folder. You can edit "config.json" to choose colour schemes, currently only scheme "0" and "1" are available, the "0" being what most people expect (green healthbar for enemies that are full health) and "1" being the "inverted" version (full health enemies have red health bar).
<br />
